text:
I had my teeth scaled, had an X-ray, and planned my dental work at Dental District Ratchapruek. I was so impressed! 🦷✨
The dentist gave me very detailed advice, checked every area before starting the procedure, and explained the procedure clearly. He didn't rush me at all, which made me feel completely at ease.

The dentist was very gentle during the scaling, and it didn't hurt at all. The staff were lovely and friendly, taking good care of me from the counter until the end. The clinic atmosphere is clean and beautiful, like a cafe. ☕️💙

If you're looking for a good dental clinic, I highly recommend this one. It's a great value, both in terms of service and attention. 💯
